findings.label: Metric value styling gap
findings.description: renderMetrics emits bare <strong> tags with no class. The CSS defines .sim-metric-value for styled metric numbers but has no .sim-metric strong selector, so values render as plain browser-bold rather than the intended styled chip.
findings.action: Add class="sim-metric-value" to each <strong> in the renderMetrics template string in js/simulation.js.

findings.label: engine.js touched despite untouched constraint
findings.description: The task spec listed engine.js as a file that must not be changed. It received a two-line guard (if (!ai.useAi) return) in rerouteAiVehicles. The change is semantically correct — without it the baseline run's null predictor throws on .forecastAll() — but contradicts the stated constraint.
findings.action: Formally accept this as a necessary scope exception, or move the null-predicate guard into the caller so engine.js stays untouched.
